description: Reopen r-sort-3-corpus-accdb (ACCDB) read-only. For each of 21 prefix and class patterns reads the IDs of SELECT ID FROM T WHERE K LIKE pattern ORDER BY ID; for each of 10 literals reads the IDs for K = literal and for K LIKE literal (no wildcard). Asks the exact matching row sets over the corpus that an interval derived from native keys would have to contain; no plan or index choice is observed.
